prompt: A freshly bootstrapped cluster ships with its default alert configuration. Which alerts are enabled by default?
explanation: Out of the box, only two cluster alerts are enabled: cluster_license_about_to_expire, which fires 7 days before the license expires by default, and cluster_users_count_approaches_limit, which fires at 90% of the 32,000-user maximum on new clusters. Capacity alerts such as node memory utilization and the multiple-nodes-down alert must be enabled explicitly.
